ecmwf_documentation.expected_period_note: ERA5 hourly reanalysis accumulations are over the 1-hour processing period ending at the validity time; monthly-averaged products scale accumulations to per-day. Forecast-type (fc) records with stepType=accum represent the interval reference_time -> reference_time+step. Our artifacts are dataType=fc with two records/day; whether CDS returned step=12 windows (12 h each) or something else CANNOT be settled from the artifact file itself - live reproduction required.
